name: Adfa – Advertising Campaign Manager for WooCommerce
author: Ali Mousavi

sections.description:
Adfa helps you create, manage, and analyze advertising campaigns based on your WooCommerce data.

With Adfa, you can:

  • Create and manage advertising campaigns
  • Select products for each campaign
  • Track sales generated by campaigns
  • Analyze campaign performance
  • Use WooCommerce order and product data to measure campaign results

How to Use

  1. Install and activate Adfa.
  2. Create a new campaign.
  3. Select the products associated with the campaign.
  4. Configure your campaign information.
  5. Use the campaign reports to analyze performance.

WooCommerce Data

Adfa uses WooCommerce order and product data to calculate campaign performance.

The plugin works with your existing WooCommerce store data and does not require you to manually enter sales information.

Premium Features

Advanced reports and additional features may be available with a premium license.

Documentation

For more information, documentation, and usage instructions, visit the plugin documentation website.

Support

For support and bug reports, visit the plugin support page.

Privacy

Adfa uses data from your WooCommerce store to provide campaign management and reporting features.

The plugin does not send your store data to external services unless a feature explicitly requires communication with an external service.

License

Adfa is licensed under the GPL-2.0-or-later license.
